item.title: Exa 3.0 Tops Eight Benchmarks: The Number to Actually Watch Is the 0.3 Margin
item.description: Exa shipped 3.0 on 10-19: first place on all eight self-reported benchmarks, but the BrowseComp lead over Perplexity is 0.3 points. What actually changes the cost curve is Dynamic Highlights (95% fewer context tokens) plus Exa Lite at $4/1000 requests; independent scoring puts Exa at 80, tied for first.
